wol.help: Sends a magic packet that switches on a computer whose network card has Wake on LAN enabled. The computer has to be on a network the router is connected to.
wol.no_program: etherwake is not installed, so no packets can be sent.
wol.pick_host: Choose a device the router has seen
wol.mac_invalid: Enter a MAC address like aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.
wol.interface_help: The network the computer is connected to.
wol.broadcast_help: Some network cards only react to a packet sent to everyone.
wol.password_help: Only for network cards that require one: 4 or 6 bytes in hex (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff) or like an IPv4 address.
wol.password_invalid: Enter 4 or 6 bytes in hex, or four numbers like an IPv4 address.
wol.saved_help: Devices to wake with one click. Those marked for it are also woken whenever the router starts.
wol.name: Name
wol.on_boot_help: Sent by the etherwake service at boot, on the default interface.
wol.default_interface_help: Used for saved devices and at boot.
